scheme_name: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond)
other_conditions: Farmer must hold a minimum of 0.20 ha land in the Kokan region or 0.40 ha land elsewhere in Maharashtra
The applicant's land must be technically suitable for digging a farm pond to store runoff rainwater
For ponds without inlet and outlet, there must be a natural source to lift and store extra runoff during the rainy season
The farmer must not have previously availed any subsidy for a farm pond, community tank, bodi in paddy bunding, or any other government scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a financial subsidy of Rs 14,433 to Rs 75,000 per farmer for constructing an individual farm pond.
